summary: Gyomu Concept is a core architectural tool for analyzing, building, and managing structured software project concepts, directories, and packages. It provides comprehensive capabilities for generating, translating, and rendering structured documentation and project README files using dedicated builders and context management.
responsibilities: Model and process structural concepts for software packages and directories.
Generate structured documentation and markdown files from definitions and project contexts.
Manage project README generation and coordinate specialized section builders.

capabilities.name: Directory Concept Management
capabilities.description: Builds, processes, loads, and saves structured conceptual representations of source code directories and their file summaries.

capabilities.name: Package Concept Management
capabilities.description: Analyzes, builds, loads, saves, and processes package-level concepts and their dependency collections.

capabilities.name: Documentation Generation and Rendering
capabilities.description: Generates, translates, renders, and constructs structured documentation and sections asynchronously using definitions and contexts.

capabilities.name: README Orchestration
capabilities.description: Orchestrates the generation and configuration of project README files with specialized builders for overview, architecture, dependencies, and development sections.

design_decisions: Uses distinct modular boundaries for directories, packages, documentation, and README generation.
Employs an asynchronous builder pattern for constructing document sections and elements.
Integrates specialized analysis and AI compilation components to support concept and documentation generation.
usage_guidance: Use the package and directory modules to analyze, build, and process structural concepts across project paths.
Leverage the document and README modules to initialize build contexts and generate structured markdown documentation using asynchronous builders and custom definitions.
